Large page with a heavy menu still extracts

By Asha Rao

The city council met on Tuesday to discuss the new drainage plan, and members asked for a clear timeline before the monsoon returns. Officials said the work would begin in the eastern wards first, where water collected for several days last year.

Officials said the work would begin in the eastern wards first, where water collected for several days last year. Residents who spoke at the meeting welcomed the plan, but several of them asked how the cost would be shared between the wards.

Residents who spoke at the meeting welcomed the plan, but several of them asked how the cost would be shared between the wards. The commissioner said a detailed report would be placed before the council next month, with estimates for each stage of the work.

The commissioner said a detailed report would be placed before the council next month, with estimates for each stage of the work. Traders in the old market said they hoped the repairs would not close the main road during the festival season.
